name: Storm Pilot
body:
The howling gales of storms were your lullaby as a child, and you quickly learned to anticipate the winds’ danger as well as parse their song.

Benefit(s) You gain a +2 trait bonus on Profession (sailor) checks, and you treat the wind force of environmental wind effects (see Table: Wind Effects) as one step less powerful for the purposes of determining any penalties on ranged attacks and Fly checks as well as whether you would be checked or blown away.
